name: SubmitHub Free Paid Blog Playlist Influencer Submission Route
country: Global / music blog, playlist, influencer, label and radio-style curator submission marketplace
feeAmount: Official public pages describe SubmitHub as a music submission marketplace with free and premium credit options; premium/packages and curator targeting require owner approval before use.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for signup/login, track upload or streaming-link submission, curator filtering, standard versus premium credit selection, package purchase decisions, genre targeting, feedback options, rights and campaign reporting. No account was created, no credits were used and no song was submitted.
notes: Official SubmitHub pages expose a public submit-music route for blogs, Spotify playlisters, TikTok/Instagram influencers and other curators, with standard/free and premium credit mechanics. Public music-submission email was not observed; route is app/form based and queued for manual review.

name: LabelRadar Free Credits Record Label Demo Submission Route
country: Global / electronic music and record-label demo submission platform
feeAmount: Official/public LabelRadar materials describe monthly free artist credits with additional paid credits available; label targeting and demo submission should be owner approved.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for account creation, demo upload, label targeting, one-to-many submission choices, paid credit purchase, remix-contest participation, label communication, rights ownership and contract/label-response handling. No account was created and no demo was uploaded.
notes: Public LabelRadar/Beatport pages describe demo submission to labels, monitoring submissions, feedback, discovery, artist-label collaboration, remix contests and a large artist/label network. No usable public music-submission email was observed; route is app based.

name: One Submit Paid Curator Playlist Blog Radio Label Campaign Route
country: Global / independent music promotion platform for Spotify playlists, blogs, radio, YouTube, TikTok and labels
feeAmount: Official page says services are not free and campaign scope/budget is selected by the artist; owner approval required before any campaign spend.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for app sign-in, campaign type, track upload/link, campaign budget, curator targeting across Spotify/blog/radio/YouTube/TikTok/label channels, written-review terms, refund rules, genre fit and payment authorization. No login was used and no campaign was started.
notes: Official One Submit pages expose Promote Your Music / app.one-submit.com route, describe 2,200 Spotify playlist curators, YouTube channels, TikTok influencers, online radio stations, independent music blogs and label submission options, plus support contact form. Public music-submission email was not observed.

name: Indiemono Free Spotify Playlist Discovery Submission Form Route
country: Global / Spain-based independent curator and Spotify playlist submission route
feeAmount: Official Indiemono submission page states the playlist submission system is free and accepts released Spotify track URLs; optional PR/label/radio/blog/TikTok/sync interest fields require owner review.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for form consent, Spotify track URL selection, genre/category selection, optional agency/service interest fields, territory selection, cookie choices, privacy/newsletter consent and release-fit checks. No form was submitted and no consent choice was made.
notes: Official Indiemono page exposes a public submission form asking for name/company, email, track/artist, Spotify track URL, closest genre, service interests and territories; it says they do not reply to email/Facebook submissions, so email outreach is not a valid route.

name: For The Love Of Bands Free Paid Playlist Review Submission Route
country: Global / Netherlands-linked indie music blog, playlists, YouTube compilation and review submission route
feeAmount: Official submit page says regular Spotify playlist submission is free, while skip-the-queue merch deal, donation/engagement and some services such as press release/interview are paid/manual boundaries.
manualReviewReason: Owner review required for selecting free regular versus paid skip-queue/donation/engagement options, playlist fit, review or YouTube-compilation route, embedded third-party forms/integrations, any payment/support option and consent. No form was submitted and no payment route was opened.
notes: Official submit page exposes playlist, review and YouTube compilation submission options. Contact page lists general, advertising and support emails but explicitly says unsolicited music submissions will be deleted and artists should use the submit page, so observed emails are not queued as usable music-submission email routes.
